name: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S
summary: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is a liquid concrete admixture based on Sika® FerroGard® technology for use in reinforced concrete and mortar. It acts as a corrosion inhibitor for the steel reinforcement. By using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S, the life expectancy and durability of reinforced concrete can be substantially increased.
metaDescription: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is a liquid concrete admixture based on Sika® FerroGard® technology for use in reinforced concrete and mortar. Protection from the destructive influences of reinforcement corrosion
No negative influences on the properties of both the fresh and the hardened concrete
usage:
Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is designed for reinforced concrete particularly at risk of corrosion. It specifically provides protection from chloride-induced corrosion.

advantages: By using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S both the anodic and cathodic reactions of the electrochemical corrosion process are reduced. The product forms a protective layer on the steel surface which delays the onset of corrosion and also reduces the corrosion rate.
Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is a combination of organic corrosion inhibitors.
The following advantages can be achieved using Sika® FerroGard®-901 S:
Corrosion protection for embedded reinforcing steel, especially from chloride attack
Protection from the destructive influences of reinforcement corrosion
No negative influences on the properties of both the fresh and the hardened concrete

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 months shelf life from date of production if stored properly in undamaged, unopened, original sealed packaging.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Storage at temperatures between 1 °C and 35 °C. Protect from direct sun-light, frost and contamination.

items.label: Concreting guidance
items.text: The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, are to be followed. Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new mix design or producing new concrete components. Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.

items.label: Specific advice
items.text: Frozen Sika® FerroGard®-901 S can be used after slow thawing at room temperature, followed by intense stirring.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S is mixed with the gauging water or added at the same time into the concrete mixer. It may also be added to the concrete in the transit mixer at the point of discharge. In this case, an additional mixing time of at least 1 minute per m3 concrete must be observed. Before discharging it, check the concrete visually for uniform consistency. The quantity of Sika® FerroGard®-901 S in the mix design should be taken into consideration when determining the quantity of water for a specific w/c-ratio.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text: Sika® FerroGard®-901 S can be combined with many other Sika products. Note: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact Sika® technical service for more information and advice.
